stages.name: bind_and_extract_event_core
stages.reads: about 1.9 GB logical for times, labels, DARTsort PTP amplitude, and localization; HDF5 metadata first
stages.ram: 2-6 GB with 1M-row chunks; avoid loading collisioncleaned TPCA or NPZ clustering matrices
stages.wall_time: 10-40 minutes depending on shared-storage throughput and hashing
stages.output: local compact columnar or memmap arrays plus hashes; expected 1.5-2.5 GB

stages.name: unit_and_time_metrics
stages.wall_time: 10-45 minutes for counts, presence, ISI, short intervals, median depth, and DARTsort-specific point noise cutoff
stages.output: about 1872 unit rows plus compact summaries
stages.stop: unsorted times within unit after explicit sort, out-of-range samples, label/cardinality mismatch, or state lattice absent when state metrics requested

stages.name: optional_exact_block_bootstrap
stages.reads: compact event arrays; no raw voltage
stages.ram: 8-32 GB depending on exact per-draw amplitude implementation
stages.wall_time: benchmark required; plan 1-4 hours for 1000 draws, not a promise
stages.output: per-draw deltas only after a new frozen contract and known-answer fixture excluding the maximum-bearing block
stages.stop: any attempt to reuse frozen all-session amplitude histogram edges or any timing fixture over 4 hours without a predeclared draw-count rule

stages.name: optional_sampled_waveform_shape
stages.reads: 2.77 GB sampled waveforms and 3 MB indices
stages.output: normalized-unit waveform shape/PTP distributions; never physical-uV pass counts
stages.stop: sample-index binding mismatch, sparsity mismatch, or nonfinite waveforms

invalidation_conditions: matching1.h5 SHA-256 or schema changes after contract freeze

physical microvolt thresholds are applied to the normalized recording
DARTsort PTP or SI peak voltage is relabeled as Kilosort PC norm/amplitude
